command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
path = 'parsing/html/html.go'
s = open(path).read()
old = '''\t"form":       true,
\t"h1":         true,'''
new = '''\t"form":       true,
\t"dd":         true,
\t"dt":         true,
\t"h1":         true,'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '''\t"main":       true,
\t"menu":       true,'''
new = '''\t"li":         true,
\t"main":       true,
\t"menu":       true,'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '''\t"ol":         true,
\t"pre":        true,'''
new = '''\t"ol":         true,
\t"option":     true,
\t"optgroup":   true,
\t"pre":        true,'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '''\t"section":    true,
\t"table":      true,'''
new = '''\t"section":    true,
\t"table":      true,
\t"td":         true,
\t"th":         true,
\t"tr":         true,'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(path, 'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w parsing/html/html.go && go build ./parsing/html/ && go test ./parsing/html/ 2>&1 | tail -5
